text.tagline: Original acrylic paintings, prints and commissions from the Southern Highlands, NSW.
text.bio:
Carelyn Madaschi is a contemporary artist based in the Southern Highlands in New South Wales whose work spans bold portraits, abstract landscapes, emotionally resonant self-reflections, and whimsical playfulness. With a background in economics and accounting, painting became her therapeutic conduit: a space where colour, form, and raw emotion merge.

Across subjects and styles, Carelyn’s work is unified by layered acrylic textures, expressive brushwork, and vibrant palettes. She invites collectors into a world shaped by introspection, energy, healing, and delight, where every piece reflects a moment, feeling, or idea made visible.

Every original is signed and ready to hang, and many are also available as prints.
